issue.title: Stale search-highlight golden: prompt_search_highlight_120x40.png drifts at HEAD
issue.description:
# Stale search-highlight golden: prompt_search_highlight_120x40.png drifts at HEAD

`just test-visual -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_prompt_highlighting.py`
reports `prompt_search_highlight_120x40.png` as updated on a clean master tree.
Observed in workspace sase_38 at master f37f1dd48, both with unrelated working-tree
changes (dispatch context line work) and with every tracked change stashed
(pristine runs eb817bc3cbe74f728b8ce66c8efcaf4b and 4e124f6a4cf942bc8a9751519e8da0b6:
updated=1, unchanged=26 in isolation in both cases).

Pixel diff is confined to a ~61x24px box over the `1/3` search-count pill in the
prompt search row (pill background shade / glyph raster); the dispatch Target/Source
line is absent from both golden and candidate, so this is unrelated to dispatch
context work. Per plan policy it was deliberately NOT regenerated here.

## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_prompt_highlighting.py::test_prompt_search_highlight_png_snapshot`

Deterministic, not a flake: fails identically in isolated runs on the pristine tree
and on the tree with unrelated changes. (A sibling node from the same file,
`test_prompt_search_count_pill_png_snapshot_flexoki`, drifted only in one combined
9-file run and passes in isolation, so that one has a flake signature and is noted
here only as an observation, not claimed.)

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails identically in isolated just test-visual runs on the pristine tree (changes stashed) and with unrelated changes; combined-run count updated=1/unchanged=26 twice. Not intermittent in isolation.

payload.description: Sibling stale-golden report for different PNG nodes (axe/family/launch-bar/link-rail); same deliberate-regeneration remedy, different source drift
Verify new task state and link

evidence.note: Independent report from sase-16n.11.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1), relayed by the sase-16n.11 land agent: the sibling node tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_prompt_highlighting.py::test_prompt_search_count_pill_png_snapshot_flexoki also drifts at HEAD. Its search-count pill '/' sigil renders orange in the golden but purple in the capture. It drifted both with and without the project-tag fixture pin, so it predates the tag work and is not a tag-caused change. It is the same stale prompt-search pill golden family, and the remediation is the same: regenerate and inspect the pill goldens (include the flexoki node).
